note: IMPORTANT ENTITY MISMATCH: the batch record is 'M.K.U PRIVATE LIMITED' with legal_claimed 'M K U LIMITED'. ImportKey slugs 'm-k-u-private-limited' and 'mku-private-limited' both returned empty template pages (0 shipment rows rendered, no address, no totals), while slug 'm-k-u-limited' returned a populated record with address 13, Gandhi Gram G.T. Road and 5253 shipments. So the confirmed shipment history belongs to M K U LIMITED (the claimed legal name), NOT to a distinct 'M.K.U PRIVATE LIMITED' entity — the two must not be merged without registry confirmation of the CIN, which could not be obtained (zaubacorp/thecompanycheck 403). HS DISCREPANCY: declared_hs 853010 (railway/tramway signalling equipment) does not match observed trade: imports are 39269099, 85414100, 69091990 and exports 63079099, 39201092 — the company is a ballistic-protection / electro-optics manufacturer (bullet-proof panels, ceramic plates, binoculars), not a signalling-equipment supplier. Per project rule 3 this is not a rejection ground: keep the company, correct the code to the actual observed HS (63079099 / 39201092 on the export side), verdict accepted_hs_corrected. Source counter: 1 populated customs page vs 2 empty template pages for the 'PRIVATE LIMITED' slug variants; 5 shipment rows actually read on the populated page out of 5253 claimed. Export status is confirmed by dated customs rows with destination, HS and B/L numbers, not by website claims. Domestic status remains unknown — no GST or tender evidence was reachable, so no domestic-supply conclusion is drawn.
